verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is a self-hosted agent gateway with HTTP APIs, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair axis for it. The evidence never documents minting scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. SecretRefs cover secret storage, sandbox "scopes" cover execution isolation, and per-agent or per-cell auth and tokens give separation between instances, not permission-scoped credential issuance. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
